{{Season|Fall}} |Sell Price = 200 |jePrice = {{Price|600}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, and {{Season|Fall}}. Mature plants yield [[Joja Veggie]] after 13 days. Seeds can only be purchased from [[Joja Emporium]] after completing the [[Stardew:JojaMart|Joja Community Development Form]] and viewing [[Morris|Morris']] 10-hearts event. They can also be obtained by placing Joja Veggie in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Joja Veggie per harvest, with a 1% chance of extra produce per harvest and a 2% chance of extra harvest per [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Joja Veggie}} {{clear}}
